No entry fee. No tour group script. Just the sea, the goddess of the sea's shrine, and whatever you brought with you.

facebook.caption:
27,046 reviews. 4.6 stars. Vinpearl Safari Phú Quốc keeps delivering.

This isn't a caged zoo. It's an open conservation park where rare native species and exotic animals roam across Bãi Dài. You ride through on a tram. Animals are that close.

One of the biggest wildlife parks in Southeast Asia, and it sits right here on the island. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.

facebook.caption:
9,825 people rated this place. Most tourists on the island have no idea it exists.

Phu Quoc Prison History Museum sits at 350 Đ. Nguyễn Văn Cừ. French colonial prison. Vietnam War POWs. Mannequins showing exactly what happened inside these walls.

Not comfortable. Not supposed to be. But if you want to understand Phu Quoc beyond the beach, this is 2 hours that will stay with you.

4.3 stars. Go. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
